info.title: AdSense Management API

requests.description: Lists all accounts available to this user.
requests.name: GET /v2/accounts
requests.note: Replace {{ADSENSE_MANAGEMENT_API_KEY}} with your API key

requests.description: Generates an ad hoc report.
requests.name: GET /v2/{account}/reports:generate
requests.note: Replace {{ADSENSE_MANAGEMENT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Generates a csv formatted ad hoc report.
requests.name: GET /v2/{account}/reports:generateCsv
requests.note: Replace {{ADSENSE_MANAGEMENT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.name: GET /v2/{parent}/adunits
requests.note: Replace {{ADSENSE_MANAGEMENT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Creates an ad unit. This method can only be used by projects enabled for the [AdSense for Platforms](https://developers.google.com/adsense/platforms/) product. Note that ad units can only be created for ad clients with an "AFC" product code. For more info see the [AdClient resource](/adsense/management/reference/rest/v2/accounts.adclients). For now, this method can only be used to create `DISPLAY` ad units. See: https://support.google.com/adsense/answer/9183566
requests.name: POST /v2/{parent}/adunits
requests.note: Replace {{ADSENSE_MANAGEMENT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values
